issues.finding: The source comment names first-order-logic although the file path and mvl/seq/rul ID place this section in many-valued logic.
issues.proposed_resolution: Correct the target part comment to many-valued-logic, retaining the frozen source and file ID.

issues.finding: After displaying Gamma_1 through Gamma_n, the definition says each Gamma_1 is a finite sequence. The universal condition must range over every indexed component Gamma_i; the singular/plural wording is also inconsistent.
issues.proposed_resolution: State in the target that each Gamma_i is a finite, possibly empty sequence of sentences.

issues.finding: The derivability definition writes Gamma Proves[L] A for the positive assertion but ends with Gamma Proves/ A for its negation, omitting the logic index even though the assertion is relative to the same logic L.
issues.proposed_resolution: Carry the [L] index onto the slash-negated Proves relation in the target.
